subject: wo-exp-pri
title: WO.EXP.PRI.------VT.PLT.
description: First of two diagrams in TRF(CW)-28. The prose below identifies the structural target: 'Quite possibly the best way to understand the significance of bi-aitionalism - as a unification, spiritual and ethical insight factor - might be to examine the post-World War Two juncture in American history.' The crossing diagrams how world expansion principle structurally meets vibrational platform at the bi-aitionalism scale: WO-EXP-PRI crossed with VT-PLT. WO-EXP-PRI sits at left with the subject-arrow; VT-PLT at center-lower-right as partner-axis. The upper branch passes INFO-FM (information forum) on its way to PRI-INFO (principle information); INFO-AF-BS (information affinity basis) branches from it at INFO-FM, and SG (source initiation) branches from INFO-AF-BS. ALT-FT (alternative functionalism) runs right from the main line and carries ALT-DEF (alternative definitions) and POL-ACT. TR (transformation) lower-left, UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)) lower-center, POL-ACT (political activism) lower-right.
